> 第三章 反杀（第1页）
从摩西多大师的实验室离开后，塞恩径直穿过黑魔法学院的大片建筑，朝着自己的小窝走去。
魔索布拉城的黑魔法学院很大，高高在上的黑魔法师与黑魔法学徒们，并不生活在同一区域。
穿过高耸的教学楼，塞恩在返回自己宿舍的过程中，也遇到了不少黑魔法学徒。
但这些黑魔法学徒都和塞恩一样，一副行色匆匆的模样，很少有驻足交谈的情况。
黑魔法学院的规则很冰冷，魔法学徒之间除了附庸关系外，便只剩下了敌对，很少有所谓的“朋友”。
一片墨绿色的白鸦林，是塞恩返回自己所居住宿舍的最后一段路程。
“哼哼哼，塞恩，疤脸乔克说的果然没错，你竟然受了这么重的伤势。”
“与其在忍受伤势的痛苦中死去，不如我现在就帮你解脱吧！”一阵尖锐的冷笑传来。
只见一名穿着黑袍，戴着白色面具魔法学徒，突然从道路两旁的白鸦林中跃出。
这名魔法学徒的身高与塞恩接近，只不过与塞恩拥有一头令人羡慕的金色短发不同的是，这名学徒的发色是灰白杂色。
塞恩和这个名为伊尔克的学徒间的争端，源自于十年前塞恩刚来幽暗地域那会儿，为了争夺一口吃的不被饿死，曾一拳击倒了一个同被掳掠到地底世界的同龄人。
不幸的是，那个家伙正好是眼前这个伊尔克的弟弟。
十年时间过去，曾经刚来幽暗地域手无缚鸡之力的人类儿童，如今均已成长为低级黑魔法学徒。
因为当年食物不够，又被塞恩一拳击倒，伊尔克的那个弟弟，终究没撑到黑魔法学院派人来测试初始精神力的时候。
虽说那个小家伙就算没被饿死，也不一定能达到符合黑魔法学院的招徒标准。
但显然伊尔克把这份仇怨，彻底算到了塞恩身上。
至于说当年伊尔克为什么不找塞恩报仇，可能是塞恩超过寻常儿童的力气和表现，吓到了他。
这十年来，塞恩和伊尔克在魔索布拉城的黑魔法学院争斗不下十数次。

其中甚至有两次，双方都差点要了对方的命。
正是这种仇怨叠加下来，双方已经到了不死不休的程度。
类似塞恩和伊尔克这种学徒间的矛盾，在魔索布拉城很常见。
且奇怪的是，那些高高在上的黑魔法师们并不制止这种内斗的发生，反而会饶有兴趣的看着这些小家伙们互斗至死。
或许对于黑魔法师们来讲，这就是他们实验之余，一场有趣的助兴节目。
时间拖得太长，可能会引来学院监察者和其它黑魔法学徒的干涉。
所以在冷冷嘲笑了塞恩几句后，伊尔克立即动手。
与塞恩修习掌握的是部分火系魔法不同，伊尔克擅长的是植物系魔法。
甚至因为在黑魔法学院种植园的出色表现，这家伙还得到过一张学院赏赐的低级魔法道具——苍白面具，就是伊尔克此时脸上戴着的那张。
从这里亦能看出，没有足够的实力，连给塞恩当对手也不够资格。
三根绿锋箭矢在伊尔克的低声吟唱中，从他的面前发射。
正常的绿锋箭矢魔法只有两根，伊尔克此时能够释放出三根，说明他和塞恩一样，已经十分接近中级学徒水准！

> Chapter 3 Counterattack (Page 1)
After leaving Master Moshedo's laboratory, Thane walked straight through the large buildings of the Black Magic Academy and walked towards his den.
The Black Magic Academy in the city of Mensobra is very large, and the high-ranking black magicians and black magic apprentices do not live in the same area.
After passing through the towering teaching building, Thain also met many black magic apprentices as he returned to his dormitory.
But these black magic apprentices were all like Thain. They looked like they were in a hurry and rarely stopped to talk.
The rules of the Black Magic Academy are very cold. Apart from the vassal relationship, there is only hostility between the magic apprentices, and there are very few so-called "friends".
A dark green forest of white crows is the last part of Thain's journey back to the dormitory where he lives.
"Hmph, Thain, Scarface Jock is indeed right, you are actually so seriously injured."
"Instead of dying in the pain of enduring your injuries, why don't I help you get rid of it now!" A sharp sneer came.
I saw a magic apprentice wearing a black robe and a white mask suddenly jumping out of the white crow forest on both sides of the road.
The height of this magic apprentice is close to that of Thain, but unlike Thain who has an enviable short golden hair, this apprentice's hair color is gray and white.
The dispute between Thane and this apprentice named Ilk originated from when Thain first came to the Underdark ten years ago. In order to fight for a bite to eat so as not to starve to death, he once knocked down a peer who was also kidnapped to the underground world with one punch.
Unfortunately, that guy happened to be the younger brother of Ilk in front of him.
Ten years have passed, and the human children who once came to the Underdark Realm without any power have now grown into low-level black magic apprentices.
Because there was not enough food and he was knocked down by Thane with a punch, Ilk's younger brother did not survive until the time when the Black Magic Academy sent someone to test his initial mental strength.
Although even if the little guy didn't starve to death, he might not be able to meet the requirements of the Black Magic Academy for recruiting disciples.
But it's obvious that Ilk placed this grudge entirely on Thain.
As for why Irk didn't seek revenge from Thain back then, it might be that Thain's strength and performance beyond that of ordinary children scared him.
In the past ten years, Thane and Irk have fought at the Black Magic Academy in Mensobra City more than ten times.
On two occasions, both sides almost killed each other.
It is this kind of hatred that has accumulated and the two sides have reached the point where they are fighting to the death.
Conflicts between apprentices like Thane and Irk are common in the city of Mensobra.
And the strange thing is that the high-ranking black magicians do not stop this kind of internal fighting from happening. Instead, they watch these little guys fighting each other to the death with great interest.
Perhaps for the black magicians, this is an interesting entertainment program besides their experiments.
Delaying it for too long may lead to interference from the academy inspectors and other black magic apprentices.
So after coldly mocking Thane, Ilk immediately took action.
Unlike Thain who mastered some fire magic, Ilk was good at plant magic.
Even because of his outstanding performance at the Black Magic Academy Plantation, this guy even received a low-level magic item as a reward from the academy - the pale mask, which is the one Ilk is wearing on his face at this time.
It can also be seen from this that he does not have enough strength to even be qualified to be an opponent for Thain.
Three green-edged arrows were launched from in front of Ilk as he chanted in a low voice.
There are only two normal green-edged arrow magics, but Ilk can release three at this time, which shows that like Thain, he is very close to the intermediate apprentice level!
